title: Indirect Value of Public Infrastructure Technology
authors: Jialu Liu; Siqi Pei; Xiaoquan Zhang
eligible_reason: Main design is a spatial regression discontinuity in distance to pollution monitoring stations (rdrobust, Tables 2-3). The only DiD-type regression (regress corruption LRxpost03 LongRiver post03) uses a single common post-2003 date with a pooled LongRiver dummy and no FE. Not staggered.
design_notes: code.do: rdrobust corruption dist (ASIF.dta, CPES.dta) with triangular/Epanechnikov/uniform kernels; regress corruption LRxpost03 LongRiver post03, vce(cluster city_id).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: post03 = year > 2003, common to all firms.
data_files_note: README: ASIF (NBS China) and CPES are licensed and cannot be shared; only code, ado files, log and output Table.xlsx shipped.
